tagline: A living form, shaped by us.
intro: Touch it. Change it. Leave something behind.

add_limb.label: Grow Limb
add_limb.hint: Inside the skin: an internal fibre. Near its edge: an outward appendage. Full growth takes 36–72 hours.

grow_eye.label: Grow Eye
grow_eye.hint: Choose living tissue with room for a socket. A bud opens and develops over 24–48 hours.

feed_mass.label: Feed Mass
feed_mass.hint: Thicken tissue from within or swell the nearby boundary. Absorption takes 8–24 hours.
